component.name: MemOS Desktop
component.summary: Native memory explorer and graph viewer for the MemOS memory store

description.p: MemOS Desktop is a native GPUI application for browsing the MemOS SQLite memory store. It opens the store strictly read-only, renders searchable, keyset-paginated memory lists, and visualizes five graph modes (namespace, tag, entity, temporal, and contradictions) with a warm obsidian interface.
An optional Write mode delegates creates, edits, deletes, review actions, and document ingest to a MemOS MCP stdio child so embeddings, provenance, and tamper logs stay intact.
